title: Unverified read for triage
description: Stakeholder directive, in the context of Stakeholder directive: the library must carry the workshop user journeys; QR Code Generation, 11. Verifying a certificate. Stakeholder directive: the library must carry the workshop user journeys: “lightweight QR scan reads basic vaccine metadata without requiring full cryptographic verification at the household edge”.

statements.label: Unverified read for triage
statements.requirement: The verifier SHALL offer an explicitly named unverified read (read-unverified) that decodes an HC1 string up to and including the payload without any trust lookup or signature check, for display and triage where verification is not possible, such as a community health worker offline at a household (journey J2). Its result type SHALL be distinct from a verified result, SHALL carry the kid and the claims it found, and SHALL state that nothing in it is verified. It SHALL apply the same decode limits as verify.
